detail.longDescription: Was chatting with @ hayzam yesterday about Sylve and integrating daemonless ( https:// daemonless.io ) directly into it. Seeing it turn painful setups like Grafana and VictoriaMetrics into 10-second deployments is exactly why we're doing this. It hit on a familiar feeling: remember when getting a new phone was exciting? Setting up every app, tweaking configs, logging into everything. Nowadays, it's just a chore you want over with. Babysitting packages and doing low-level sysadmin work on standalone jails feels the exact same way. Wrote down some thoughts on moving past that friction: https:// ahze.net/posts/the-new-phone-f eeling/ # FreeBSD # daemonless # Sylve # containers # SelfHosted # SysAdmin
